description: Every table in the database either holds personal data and is covered by an IErasureParticipant (src/App.Data/Erasure.cs), or is listed here with the reason it holds none. ErasureTests fails on a table that is in neither, so a new table cannot ship without that decision. Log redaction: Redact.Url and Redact.Email (src/App.Api/Redact.cs); no person's address, email or name in a log line.

tablesWithoutPersonalData.ops.SchemaMigration: The migration ledger: file names and hashes.
tablesWithoutPersonalData.ops.RateCounter: Hashed partitions and counts; the address is hashed, never stored, and rows expire within minutes.
tablesWithoutPersonalData.app.Tag: Tag names chosen by the product, not about a person.
